components: Role Badge (Supervisor, Finance Admin, Super Admin)

components_and_visual_enhancers.kpi_cards: Flat solid white cards with subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0), top accent strip in Electric Lime (#B9F36B) or status color, crisp clear typography, right-aligned metric trends, data-testid attributes
components_and_visual_enhancers.data_tables: Sticky table headers, dense layout with horizontal borders (#F1F5F9), status badges, search input, date range filters, pagination controls, right-aligned monetary values formatted in INR (₹)
components_and_visual_enhancers.dialogs_and_modals: Shadcn Dialog primitives with backdrop shadow, high contrast header, clear explicit action buttons
components_and_visual_enhancers.reconciliation_queue: Split-pane layout comparing Bank Statement lines vs Fleet Collection logs with auto-match candidate badges, mismatch confidence score, and resolution dialog
components_and_visual_enhancers.import_mapping_wizard: 4-step stepper (Upload CSV/XLSX -> Map Columns -> Validation Preview -> Import Result) with visual column target dropdowns

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard in React JS using clean component decomposition.
Ensure all monetary amounts use formatted INR (₹) with proper thousand separators (e.g., ₹1,45,200.00).
Ensure all interactive buttons, rows, filters, modals, and input fields include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='kpi-active-drivers', data-testid='payment-search-input').
Implement Google sign-in mock flow on login page with role switcher (Supervisor, Finance Admin, Super Admin).
Implement CSV/XLSX import with interactive column mapping preview for Bank Transactions & Payments.
Ensure total responsiveness for desktop and tablet screens.
Keep colors clean: Light background #F8FAFC, Midnight Navy #111827 for headers/sidebar, Electric Lime #B9F36B for primary accent triggers.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast: Use sonner for user feedback toasts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.theme_rule: Light theme requested by user. Ensure all modals, popovers, select dropdowns have explicit non-transparent backgrounds (bg-white text-[#111827]).
